senses.gloss: f. (חפס to collect, cmp. Arab. ḥafaš, a. ḥafṣ) a small leather bag, valise (for documents &c.).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 1:8">B. Mets. I, 8</cite>, expl.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 20b:4">ib. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>חמת קטנה</he>; <cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 3:3">Gitt. III, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Gittin 28a:4">ib. 28ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Yoma 75b:9">Yoma 75ᵇ</cite> <he>כמו שמונח בח׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>בקופסא</he>) as if lying (pressed) in a valise. [Also in Ch.] <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 2:4:2">Y. B. Mets. II, 8ᶜ</cite> top <he>מכסי בח׳</he> covered up with a bag. Pesik. B’shall. p. 93ᵃ [read:] <he>הדה חֲפִיסְתִּי וכ׳</he> my valise here and my cloak.
